selection: C1-D byte-preserving extraction of the static tmux launch-stage reject hints (19 fresh, 15 resume); decoded text copied from the C0 pre-extraction inventory of sourceSha and compared byte-for-byte with an independently derived expected file before the product JSON was edited; no dedupe across verbs; model-invalid, task-too-long, the shared ACP constant and the spread preflight leaf tables stay code-owned

fresh.no-tmux-context: this agent is not running inside tmux, so there is no session to open a sibling beside
fresh.anchor-malformed: TMUX_PANE is not a native pane id
fresh.anchor-unresolved: tmux resolved no pane for this agent's anchor
fresh.anchor-mismatch: tmux answered about a different pane than the one asked about
fresh.caller-identity-unavailable: this surface has no record-backed garden id for the caller, so the sibling would have no address to call back to
fresh.cwd-not-absolute: the requested cwd is not an absolute path (the value is taken literally — nothing trims or resolves it)
fresh.cwd-format-token: the requested cwd contains '#', which tmux expands as a format inside -c — it would silently rewrite the path or run a command
fresh.cwd-missing: the requested cwd does not exist; tmux would not report this, it would open the window in $HOME and look successful
fresh.cwd-not-directory: the requested cwd exists but is not a directory
fresh.tmux-session-name-invalid: the requested tmux session name is outside the shape this rail addresses (start with a letter or digit, then letters, digits, '_' or '-') — some other shapes tmux cannot resolve at all ('#' is expanded when the name is stored; '.' and ':' are its own pane/window separators inside a target; a name like '$0' loses to the session id '$0'), and the rest are declined to keep one narrow grammar, so rename the session or open one whose name fits
fresh.tmux-session-missing: no session with that exact name answers on this agent's tmux server (or that server stopped answering) — nothing was created, so open the session yourself and call again
fresh.model-empty: model is empty after trimming; fresh calls require an explicit model
fresh.runtime-unresolved: the backend's runtime is not installed on PATH
fresh.runtime-not-absolute: the resolved runtime path is not absolute
fresh.runtime-path-whitespace: the resolved runtime path contains whitespace, which tmux would re-split
fresh.runtime-missing: nothing exists at the resolved runtime path
fresh.runtime-not-regular-file: the resolved runtime path is not a regular file
fresh.runtime-not-executable: the resolved runtime path is not executable

resume.no-tmux-context: this agent is not running inside tmux, so there is no session to reopen the citizen in
resume.anchor-malformed: TMUX_PANE is not a native pane id
resume.anchor-unresolved: tmux resolved no pane for this agent's anchor
resume.anchor-mismatch: tmux answered about a different pane than the one asked about
resume.cwd-not-absolute: the recorded cwd is not an absolute path
resume.cwd-format-token: the recorded cwd contains '#', which tmux expands as a format inside -c — it would silently rewrite the path or run a command
resume.cwd-missing: the recorded cwd no longer exists; tmux would not report this, it would open the window in $HOME and look successful
resume.cwd-not-directory: the recorded cwd exists but is not a directory
resume.herdr-resume-unsupported: this agent runs inside herdr, and same-id resume has only a tmux rail — nothing was opened in any ambient tmux session
resume.runtime-unresolved: the citizen's runtime (pi or claude) is not installed on PATH
resume.runtime-not-absolute: the resolved runtime path is not absolute
resume.runtime-path-whitespace: the resolved runtime path contains whitespace, which tmux would re-split
resume.runtime-missing: nothing exists at the resolved runtime path
resume.runtime-not-regular-file: the resolved runtime path is not a regular file
resume.runtime-not-executable: the resolved runtime path is not executable
